newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANZ Bank plans major investment in 1998/99.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Bank plans major investment in 1998/99.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) on Friday said it planned to make major investments in 1998 and 1999 as part of its strategy to expand its global operations.
In notes presented to an analysts' briefing and later released to the Australian Stock Exchange, ANZ said 1998 would be the significant year for change in its global operations.
"Going global will facilitate growth ambitions as well as deliver efficiency and benefits," ANZ said in the notes.

The bank said by 1999 it aimed to have integrated its operations in Australia and New Zealand as well as created common operating processes and centralised operations in every country in which it operates.
The notes contained organisational structure charts which showed the
before and after effect of a re-organisation of the bank to create what was decribed as an integrated investment banking unit.

The new structure melds the bank's existing international division into new divisions seperated on a product basis and introduces relationship management divisions for Australasia, Europe and the Americas.
ANZ said a new culture was emerging in the bank as its global operating organisation evolved.
ANZ shares were 17 cents firmer at A$10.19 at 1.05 p.m. (0305 GMT).
